entries.title: I Corinthians 2:1
segments: And I, brethren, when I came unto you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:2
segments: For I determined not to know anything among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:3
segments: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:4
segments: And my speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:5
segments: that your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:6
segments: We speak wisdom, however, among them that are fullgrown: yet a wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nought:

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:7
segments: but we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, [even] the [wisdom] that hath been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds unto our glory:

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:8
segments: which none of the rulers of this world hath known: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory:

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:9
segments: but as it is written, Things which eye saw not, and ear heard not, And [which] entered not into the heart of man, Whatsoever things God prepared for them that love him.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:10
segments: But unto us God revealed [them] through the Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:11
segments: For who among men knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of the man, which is in him? even so the things of God none knoweth, save the Spirit of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:12
segments: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is from God; that we might know the things that were freely given to us of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:13
segments: Which things also we speak, not in words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Spirit teacheth; combining spiritual things with spiritual [words].

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:14
segments: Now the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him; and he cannot know them, because they are spiritually judged.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:15
segments: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, and he himself is judged of no man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 2:16
segments: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
